terms.Vithia-S0: context compiler (System 0); prepares context, never decides
terms.Vithia-S1: decider (System 1): JEV, OpenJev, LLM, or local model
terms.VitaState: finite persistent state with predecessor lineage (schemas/s01/VITA_STATE_V1.json)
terms.VitaTrajectory: ordered VitaStates with decisions and observed transitions (VITA_TRAJECTORY_V1.json)
terms.ContextPacket: bounded projection of a VitaState for one Question (S01_CONTEXT_PACKET_V1.json = vita01 context packet v1)
terms.ObservedTransition: S01_TRANSITION_RECEIPT_V1.json = vita01 transition receipt v1; requires an ObservationReceipt
terms.Context: versioned interpretation; successors never mutate SourceAtoms
terms.Anticube (public): operator-declared identity x safety labels; the private Anticube math is not public
terms.ΔG* (public): dimensionless information-state diagnostic G* = U* - tau H_norm; no thermodynamic claim
terms.REPLAY_LEVEL_0..4: source recoverable / environment recoverable / same inputs+seeds / equivalent within tolerance / byte-identical
terms.EXPLORATORY_REHEARSAL: runs before the confirmatory freeze; preserved, never rewritten
terms.PASS: integrity/test/verification gates only; never a scientific claim state

schema_file_names: the S01_* file names are retained; they are the VITA01 v1 schemas (no duplicate files)
